newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kohl has no plans to reshuffle cabinet --spokesman.
newsitem.headline: Kohl has no plans to reshuffle cabinet --spokesman.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl has no plans to reshuffle his cabinet, government spokesman Herbert Schmuelling told a news conference in Bonn on Monday.
Schmuelling, asked about calls by Finance Minister Theo Waigel to reshuffle the cabinet before the 1998 election, said as far as Kohl was concerned, a reshuffle was "not under consideration".
Schmuelling also said Kohl considered discussion of the issue futile. Kohl is currently on holiday in Austria.

With an eye to opinion polls showing the government's popularity sliding, Waigel said in several weekend interviews that Kohl should replace a number of ministers before launching the 1998 election campaign.
Waigel said some ministers were only trying to hang on to their jobs until the election, and urged Kohl to jettison any who were tiring well before the 1998 campaign starts.
